# Pioneer Ventures Society

> Pioneer Ventures Society (PVS) is a community organization fostering innovation and supporting new ventures through events, mentorship, and resources for aspiring entrepreneurs.

PVS runs community initiatives, hosts events, publishes blog content, and maintains a member directory. This file gives large language models and AI crawlers a quick, structured overview of the site's public content.

## Site

- Home: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/
- About / Initiatives: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/initiatives
- Events: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/events
- Blog: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/blog
- Members: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/members
- Resources: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/resources
- Merchandise: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/merch
- Compound Interest Calculator: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/calculator
- Donations: https://pioneer-ventures-society.org/donations

## Notes

- Content under /donations/success and /donations/cancel is transactional and not meant for indexing.
- The admin portal is a separate, authenticated subdomain and is not part of the public content set.
